title: Interlock playbook for cross-team roadmap handovers and dependency resolution
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Create a lightweight, repeatable playbook and checklist that standardizes how PMs coordinate roadmap handovers and resolve cross-team dependencies across Eng, Design, Security, and Infra. Scope: - Define handoff triggers (cycle gates, feature readiness, SLO risk) - Document touchpoints, RACI for design reviews, security signoff, infra provisioning - Provide templated artefacts (handoff PRD checklist, dependency matrix spreadsheet, triage cadence) - Integrate with existing tools: Linear, GitHub (PR links), Confluence/Drive (PRD), and Console dashboards Out of scope: Full automation of scheduling; separate runbooks for incident response. Success metrics: - 80% of cross-team dependencies have an assigned owner 2 weeks before cycle start - Reduce last-minute security blockers by 50% vs previous quarter - Measured reduction in missed rollout dates attributable to dependency issues
acceptance_criteria: A1: Handoff checklist doc (Confluence) published and linked in Linear templates
A2: Dependency matrix template available in Drive and seeded with current Q2 initiatives
A3: Pilot run with two feature teams (runtime and console) completed and retrospective recorded
A4: Playbook adopted in Roadmap Org Sync weekly cadence; 1st two meetings use the new agenda
A5: Security signoff SLA defined and documented (target: 5 business days)
rollout_plan: Week 1: Publish playbook draft and templates; announce in #roadmap and at roadmap sync
Week 2: Run two pilot handoffs (runtime-engineering -> console; infra->private-deploy) and capture feedback
Week 3: Iterate playbook, finalize templates, add Linear ticket template and labels
Week 4: Bake into cycle kickoff ritual and train PM/Eng leads; measure first-metrics
